releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.27 redesigns the Inbox file area as a two-column visual grid. Images show their real local thumbnail, while video, PDF, audio and other files use clear type previews. Tapping an image, video or PDF now opens it inside Smart Life instead of Android Open with; unsupported file types still use the external fallback. Inbox organization, rename, notes and Smart Life-copy-only deletion remain unchanged.
